definition_zh: 麻醉；麻醉状态；麻醉术；感觉缺失
definition_en: the loss of feeling or consciousness produced by drugs, especially during an operation
core_image: 手术灯下，病人的痛觉开关被一只药瓶轻轻关掉
scene: 手术开始前，麻醉医生把面罩扣在病人脸上，几秒后病人安静地睡去。The drug brought her into deep anesthesia before the first cut.
sceneCN: 这里 anesthesia 是「麻醉状态」（第 1 个义项：药物造成的失去感觉与意识）；句意：手术开始前，药物让她进入深度麻醉。

pos.zh: 麻醉；麻醉状态；麻醉术；感觉缺失

derivatives.zh: 麻醉剂；加形容词后缀 -etic，也可作形容词「麻醉的」
麻醉师；-ist 表人，指实施麻醉的医护人员
使麻醉；-ize 构成动词，指用药让人失去感觉
麻醉学；-logy 表学科，研究麻醉与围术期管理

senses.title: The state of being unable to feel
senses.definition: a state in which a person cannot feel pain or other sensations, usually because of drugs
senses.definitionCN: 因药物等原因而感觉不到疼痛或其他刺激的状态
senses.example: While under anesthesia, she felt no pain at all.
senses.exampleCN: 在麻醉状态下，她完全感觉不到疼痛。
senses.why: The Greek word is literally without perception: the negative prefix removes aisthesis, the act of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语原义就是「没有感觉」：否定前缀去掉了 aisthēsis（感觉），所以这个词最先指感觉被关掉的状态。

senses.title: The medical procedure that produces it
senses.definition: the use of drugs to produce this state during an operation
senses.definitionCN: 在手术中用药物产生这种状态的做法
senses.example: The operation went ahead under general anesthesia.
senses.exampleCN: 手术在全身麻醉下进行。
senses.why: Once the state became a tool of surgery, the word named the procedure itself.
senses.whyCN: 当这种状态成为手术的工具，词义就从「状态」延伸到「实施麻醉」这一过程。

senses.title: Loss of feeling in one area
senses.definition: numbness limited to one part of the body, produced by blocking the nerves that serve it
senses.definitionCN: 只出现在身体某一部分的麻木，由阻断该处神经造成
senses.example: The dentist used local anesthesia for the filling.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医补牙时用了局部麻醉。
senses.why: Blocking a single nerve reproduces the same loss of feeling on a smaller scale.
senses.whyCN: 只阻断一条神经，就能在更小的范围里重现同样的感觉缺失，于是词义缩小到身体的一处。

senses.title: Loss of sensation caused by nerve damage
senses.titleCN: 感觉缺失（神经病变所致）
senses.definition: the loss of feeling in an area of skin or body part because of injury or disease rather than drugs
senses.definitionCN: 因损伤或疾病而非药物造成的一块皮肤或身体部位的感觉丧失
senses.example: Nerve injury left a patch of anesthesia on his left cheek.
senses.exampleCN: 神经损伤在他左脸颊上留下一块感觉缺失。
senses.why: The original meaning needs no drug at all, so doctors still use it for any deadened area.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的原始义并不需要药物，所以医生仍用它指任何失去感觉的区域，词义由此回到最本来的「无感觉」。

intro.en: Anesthesia joins Greek an-, without, to aisthesis, perception, and reached English through medical Latin.
intro.cn: anesthesia 由希腊语否定前缀 an-（无）与 aisthēsis（感觉）组合而成，经医学拉丁语进入英语。

items.en: Aisthanesthai means to perceive, and the noun aisthesis means perception or feeling.
items.cn: aisthanesthai 意为感知，名词 aisthēsis 意为知觉、感觉。

items.en: The prefix an- negates the noun, giving anaisthesia, insensibility.
items.cn: 前缀 an- 否定这个名词，构成 anaisthēsia，即「无感觉、失去知觉」。

items.en: Medical Latin borrows the Greek noun as anaesthesia for the loss of feeling.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语借入这个希腊名词作 anaesthesia，指感觉的丧失。

items.en: English first records anesthesia in the early eighteenth century for a loss of feeling.
items.cn: 英语在十八世纪初首次记录 anesthesia，指失去感觉。

items.en: In the 1840s the word is applied to the drug-induced state used in surgery.
items.cn: 十九世纪四十年代，这个词被用来指手术中由药物造成的状态。

items.en: American writing settles on anesthesia while British writing keeps anaesthesia, and new types such as spinal anesthesia appear.
items.cn: 美式拼写定为 anesthesia，英式仍写 anaesthesia，并出现脊椎麻醉等新类型。

note.en: Anesthesia belongs to the Greek family of feeling, and it sits beside words for numbness and for the relief of pain.
note.cn: anesthesia 属于希腊语中表示「感觉」的一族词，旁边是麻木与镇痛一类的词。

entries.definition: the British spelling of the same state of lost feeling
entries.definitionCN: 同一词的英式拼写，指失去感觉的状态；拼写不同，词源相同

entries.definition: the person trained to give anesthesia to a patient
entries.definitionCN: 受过训练、为病人实施麻醉的人，即麻醉师

entries.definition: to put a person into a state of lost feeling with drugs
entries.definitionCN: 用药物使人进入失去感觉的状态，即实施麻醉

entries.definition: a calm, sleepy state produced by a drug, in which feeling remains
entries.definitionCN: 药物造成的平静欲睡状态，感觉仍然存在，与麻醉不完全相同

entries.definition: the loss of feeling in a part of the body
entries.definitionCN: 身体某一部分失去感觉，是麻醉的核心表现之一

entries.definition: the relief of pain without the loss of other sensation
entries.definitionCN: 只解除疼痛而其他感觉仍在，与麻醉的范围不同

normalIntro.en: Anesthesia is a Greek compound that says without feeling, and the whole medical family grows from those two pieces.
normalIntro.cn: anesthesia 是一个希腊语复合词，字面就是「没有感觉」，整族医学词都从这两块长出来。

normal.en: The prefix an- means without and aisthesis means perception, so the word is literally without feeling.
normal.cn: 前缀 an- 表「无」，aisthēsis 表「感觉」，所以这个词字面就是「没有感觉」。

normal.en: Anesthetist, anesthetic, and anesthesiology all keep the same Greek core.
normal.cn: anesthetist、anesthetic 与 anesthesiology 都保留着同一个希腊语核心。

normal.en: General anesthesia covers the whole body, while local anesthesia numbs only one part.
normal.cn: 全身麻醉覆盖整个身体，局部麻醉只让一个部位麻木。

normal.en: A patient under anesthesia feels nothing while the operation goes on.
normal.cn: 病人在麻醉状态下，手术进行时什么也感觉不到。

normal.en: British writing prefers anaesthesia, American writing prefers anesthesia.
normal.cn: 英式拼写多用 anaesthesia，美式拼写多用 anesthesia。

abstract.en: Picture a switch labelled pain being flipped to off.
abstract.cn: 想象一个标着「疼痛」的开关被拨到关闭。

abstract.en: Imagine the operating room going quiet as the drug drips into the line.
abstract.cn: 想象药液顺着管子滴入，手术室随之安静下来。

abstract.en: Think of one arm falling asleep while the rest of the body stays awake.
abstract.cn: 想象一条手臂睡着了，身体其余部分仍然清醒。

examples.en: The patient was still drowsy when the anesthesia wore off.
examples.cn: 麻醉消退时，病人仍然昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: Spinal anesthesia numbed her from the waist down.
examples.cn: 脊椎麻醉让她腰部以下失去知觉。

examples.en: The anesthetist checked the machine before the operation.
examples.cn: 麻醉师在手术前检查了麻醉机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安娜睡呀」——anesthesia 读起来像「安娜睡呀」，麻醉之后病人就睡过去了；这只是谐音联想，与希腊语词源无关。

root: 希腊语 an-（无）+ aisthēsis（感觉）→ anaisthēsia（无感觉）→ 医学拉丁语 anaesthesia → 英语 anesthesia，核心义「感觉被关掉」。

sensesIntro.en: Anesthesia begins as a state of lost feeling, becomes the surgical procedure that creates it, narrows to one numbed area, and returns to any deadened part of the body.
sensesIntro.cn: anesthesia 先指失去感觉的状态，再指造成这种状态的手术流程，随后缩小到一个麻木的部位，最后回到身体任何失去感觉的区域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the switch for pain being turned off under the operating light.
core.cn: 核心意象：手术灯下，痛觉的开关被关掉。

branches.en: The state itself is the first and most literal sense.
branches.cn: 状态本身是第一义，也是最字面的一层。

branches.en: The procedure is the state turned into a medical tool.
branches.cn: 麻醉术是把这种状态变成医疗工具后的义项。

branches.en: A blocked nerve gives the same numbness in miniature.
branches.cn: 阻断一条神经，就在小范围里重现同样的麻木。

branches.en: Damage without drugs brings the word back to bare sensation loss.
branches.cn: 非药物造成的损伤，让这个词回到纯粹的感觉丧失。

branches.en: A patient under anesthesia during an operation joins the state and the procedure.
branches.cn: 手术中处于麻醉状态的病人，把状态义与手术义连在一起。

intro.en: Anesthesia is a Greek compound of an-, without, and aisthesis, perception, and English has built a whole family around it.
intro.cn: anesthesia 是希腊语复合词，由否定前缀 an- 与 aisthēsis（感觉）组成，英语围绕它构成了整族词。

latinIntro.en: Medical Latin borrowed the Greek noun as anaesthesia and kept the sense of lost feeling.
latinIntro.cn: 医学拉丁语借入这个希腊名词作 anaesthesia，保留了「失去感觉」之义。

items.example: The prefix an- turns perception into the absence of perception.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 an- 把「感知」变成「没有感知」。

items.example: Aisthesis is the noun for the act of feeling.
items.exampleCN: aisthēsis 是表示感觉行为的名词。

items.example: Aisthanesthai is the verb behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: aisthanesthai 是这一族词背后的动词。

items.example: Anaisthesia joins the negative prefix to the noun for feeling.
items.exampleCN: anaisthēsia 把否定前缀直接加在「感觉」这个名词上。

items.example: The suffix -ia turns the stem into a name for a state.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ia 把词干变成表示状态的名词。

items.meaningCN: 麻醉；药物造成的失去感觉
items.example: Anesthesia names the state produced in surgery.
items.exampleCN: anesthesia 指手术中造成的状态。

items.meaning: the British form of the same noun
items.example: Anaesthesia is the British spelling of the same word.
items.exampleCN: anaesthesia 是同一词的英式拼写。

items.meaning: the drug, or the state of being numbed
items.example: Anesthetic names the drug that produces the state.
items.exampleCN: anesthetic 指产生这种状态的药物。

items.meaning: the one who gives the anesthetic
items.example: The suffix -ist marks the person who gives the drug.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 标出给药的那个人。

items.meaning: to put a patient into anesthesia
items.example: Anesthetize is the verb for putting a patient under.
items.exampleCN: anesthetize 是「使病人进入麻醉」的动词。

definition_zh: 外科医生；外科专科医师；军医
definition_en: a doctor who treats injuries and diseases by cutting into the body
core_image: 无影灯下，一双戴手套的手稳稳握住手术刀
scene: 手术室里，主刀医生举起手，示意护士递上器械。The surgeon scrubbed in and took her place at the table.
sceneCN: 这里 surgeon 是「外科医生」（第 1 个义项：以手术为主要治疗手段的医生）；句意：外科医生刷手消毒后站到了手术台前。

pos.zh: 外科医生；外科专科医师；军医

derivatives.zh: 外科；手术；由 surgeon 去掉表人后缀构成，指这门学科与操作本身
外科的；手术的；-ical 形容词后缀，修饰与手术相关的事物
通过外科手术地；-ly 副词后缀，说明手段是手术

senses.title: A doctor who performs operations
senses.definition: a doctor trained to treat disease and injury by operating on the body
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练、通过切开身体来治疗疾病与创伤的医生
senses.example: The surgeon removed the appendix in under an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生不到一小时就切除了阑尾。
senses.why: The Greek compound means hand work, and the surgeon is the one whose work is done with the hands.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语复合词意为「手的工作」，外科医生正是靠双手完成治疗的人，词义从「手工」落到「做手术的人」。

senses.title: A specialist in one branch of surgery
senses.definition: a doctor who operates only on a particular organ or part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 只对某一器官或某一部位动手术的医生
senses.example: A heart surgeon repaired the leaking valve.
senses.exampleCN: 一位心脏外科医生修补了渗漏的瓣膜。
senses.why: As surgery split into specialties, the plain word took on the narrower reading of a specialist operator.
senses.whyCN: 随着外科分成各专科，这个普通称呼也收窄为「某专科的开刀医生」。

senses.title: A doctor attached to a ship or an army
senses.titleCN: 随船军医；随军外科医生
senses.definition: in earlier use, a medical officer who sailed with a ship or served with troops
senses.definitionCN: 旧时随船航行或在军中服务的外科军医
senses.example: The ship surgeon treated the sailors during the long voyage.
senses.exampleCN: 随船外科医生在漫长的航程中为水手们治伤。
senses.why: At sea and at war the person who cut and stitched was the only trained hand aboard.
senses.whyCN: 在海上和战场上，会动刀缝合的人就是船上唯一受过训练的手，于是这个词又多了一层军中职称。

senses.title: A senior hospital surgeon in Britain
senses.definition: in British hospitals, a senior surgeon at consultant level who leads a surgical team
senses.definitionCN: 在英国医院里达到顾问级别、领导一个外科团队的高级外科医师
senses.example: She was appointed consultant surgeon at the teaching hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 她被任命为这家教学医院的顾问外科医师。
senses.why: The British health service kept the plain title for its most senior operating doctors.
senses.whyCN: 英国医疗体系把最资深的开刀医生仍称作 surgeon，这个职称义便从「做手术的人」升格为院内最高级别。

intro.en: Surgeon descends from Greek kheirourgia, hand work, through Latin chirurgia and Old French.
intro.cn: surgeon 源自希腊语 kheirourgia（手工作），经拉丁语 chirurgia 与古法语进入英语。

items.en: Kheir means hand and ergon means work, so kheirourgia is work done with the hands.
items.cn: kheir 意为手，ergon 意为工作，kheirourgia 就是「用手完成的活儿」。

items.en: Kheirourgos names the man who works with his hands, later the healer who operates.
items.cn: kheirourgos 指靠双手干活的人，后来专指动刀治病的人。

items.en: Medical Latin adopts chirurgia for surgery and chirurgus for the operator.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语用 chirurgia 表示外科，用 chirurgus 表示动刀的人。

items.en: Cirurgien and surgien carry the word into French.
items.cn: cirurgien 与 surgien 把这个词带进法语。

items.en: English shortens the French form to surgien and then to surgeon.
items.cn: 英语把法语词形缩短为 surgien，再演变为 surgeon。

items.en: Surgeon becomes the standard title for an operating doctor, from a ship to a consultant.
items.cn: surgeon 成为开刀医生的标准称谓，从随船军医到顾问医师都用它。

note.en: Surgeon is the hand worker of medicine, close in form to surgery and in meaning to physician and operator.
note.cn: surgeon 是医学里「用手干活的人」，形式上接近 surgery，意义上接近 physician 与 operator。

entries.definition: the branch of medicine that treats the body by cutting
entries.definitionCN: 通过切开身体来治疗疾病的医学分支，即外科

entries.definition: relating to surgery or done by a surgeon
entries.definitionCN: 与外科或手术有关的，即外科的

entries.definition: by means of an operation
entries.definitionCN: 通过手术的方式，即外科手术地

entries.definition: a doctor who treats illness with medicine rather than with cutting
entries.definitionCN: 主要以药物而非手术治病的医生，即内科医生

entries.definition: the person who carries out a particular procedure
entries.definitionCN: 实施某项操作的人，在手术语境里指动刀者

entries.definition: a person qualified to practise medicine
entries.definitionCN: 有资格行医的人，范围比外科医生大得多

normalIntro.en: Surgeon is built from a Greek hand plus work, and English made surgery, surgical, and surgically from the same stem.
normalIntro.cn: surgeon 由希腊语的「手」加「工作」构成，英语又用同一词干造出 surgery、surgical 与 surgically。

normal.en: Greek kheir means hand, so a surgeon is literally a hand worker.
normal.cn: 希腊语 kheir 意为手，所以外科医生字面上就是「用手干活的人」。

normal.en: Surgery is the field, surgical is the adjective, and surgeon is the person.
normal.cn: surgery 是领域，surgical 是形容词，surgeon 是那个人。

normal.en: A heart surgeon operates on the heart, while a plastic surgeon reshapes tissue.
normal.cn: 心脏外科医生在心脏上动刀，整形外科医生则重塑组织。

normal.en: On a ship the surgeon was the only person who could cut and stitch.
normal.cn: 在船上，外科医生是唯一能开刀缝合的人。

normal.en: In British hospitals a consultant surgeon is the senior operator on a team.
normal.cn: 在英国医院里，顾问外科医师是团队中资深的开刀者。

abstract.en: Picture a gloved hand closing around a scalpel under bright light.
abstract.cn: 想象一只戴着手套的手在强光下握住手术刀。

abstract.en: Imagine one narrow tray of instruments laid out for one organ only.
abstract.cn: 想象一盘窄窄的器械只为一个器官摆好。

abstract.en: Think of a lantern swinging on a wooden ship while a steady hand stitches a sailor.
abstract.cn: 想象木船上的灯晃动着，一只稳稳的手正在为水手缝合。

examples.en: The surgeon spoke to the family before the operation.
examples.cn: 手术前，外科医生和家属谈了话。

examples.en: Two surgeons worked together on the transplant.
examples.cn: 两位外科医生合作完成了这台移植手术。

examples.en: The surgical team finished in three hours.
examples.cn: 手术团队三个小时就完成了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「设诊」——surgeon 读起来像「设诊」，外科医生设诊开刀；这只是谐音联想，与希腊语 kheirourgia 无关。

root: 希腊语 kheir（手）+ ergon（工作）→ kheirourgia（手工作）→ 拉丁语 chirurgia → 古法语 cirurgien → 英语 surgeon，核心义「用手做治疗的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Surgeon starts as the hand worker who cuts, narrows to a specialist of one organ or region, extends to the doctor aboard a ship, and finally becomes a senior hospital rank in Britain.
sensesIntro.cn: surgeon 从「动手开刀的人」开始，收窄为某一器官或部位的专科医师，又延伸为随船军医，最后在英国成为院内的高级职称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gloved hand holding a scalpel under the operating light.
core.cn: 核心意象：无影灯下，戴着手套的手握住手术刀。

branches.en: The hand worker who operates is the plain everyday sense.
branches.cn: 动手开刀的人是日常最普通的义项。

branches.en: One organ, one operator gives the specialist sense.
branches.cn: 一个器官配一位开刀者，就长出了专科医师义。

branches.en: A ship or an army needs its own cutting hand.
branches.cn: 船和军队都需要自己那位会动刀的人。

branches.en: The British rank marks the most senior operator in a hospital.
branches.cn: 英式职称标出医院里最资深的开刀者。

branches.en: Any operating doctor, general or specialist, is first of all a surgeon.
branches.cn: 无论普通还是专科，开刀医生首先都是 surgeon。

intro.en: Surgeon carries Greek kheir, hand, and ergon, work, through Latin and French into a family with surgery and surgical.
intro.cn: surgeon 带着希腊语的 kheir（手）与 ergon（工作），经拉丁语和法语进入英语，并衍生出 surgery 与 surgical。

latinIntro.en: Latin chirurgia means surgery and chirurgus means the operator, both taken from the Greek compound.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 chirurgia 意为外科，chirurgus 意为动刀者，二者都借自那个希腊语复合词。

items.example: Kheir supplies the hand in the Greek compound.
items.exampleCN: kheir 为这个希腊语复合词提供「手」这一要素。

items.example: Ergon supplies the work in the same compound.
items.exampleCN: ergon 为同一复合词提供「工作」这一要素。

items.example: Kheirourgia is literally work done with the hands.
items.exampleCN: kheirourgia 字面就是「用手完成的活儿」。

items.example: Kheirourgos names the person who does the hand work.
items.exampleCN: kheirourgos 指做手工活的人。

items.example: Chirurgia is the Latin form of the Greek noun.
items.exampleCN: chirurgia 是这个希腊名词的拉丁语形式。

items.example: Chirurgus is the Latin name for the operator.
items.exampleCN: chirurgus 是拉丁语中对动刀者的称呼。

items.example: Cirurgien is the Old French form of the word.
items.exampleCN: cirurgien 是这个词的古法语形式。

items.example: Surgeon is the modern English form.
items.exampleCN: surgeon 是现代英语的形式。

items.example: Surgery names both the field and the act.
items.exampleCN: surgery 同时指这门学科和手术操作。

items.example: The suffix -ical forms the adjective surgical.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ical 构成形容词 surgical。

items.example: The suffix -ical builds adjectives from nouns.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ical 由名词构成形容词。

definition_en: a shop or hospital unit where medicines are prepared and sold, or the science of preparing them
core_image: 绿色十字灯箱下，一排药盒和一只数药片的小铜盘
scene: 街角的药房还亮着灯，柜台后的人正把药片数进小纸袋。The pharmacy on the corner stays open until midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 pharmacy 是「药房、药店」（第 1 个义项：配药售药的场所）；句意：街角那家药房营业到午夜。

derivatives.zh: 药剂师；-ist 表人，指在药房审方配药的专业人员
制药的；药学的；-ceutical 为形容词词尾，指与药物制造有关
药理学；-logy 表学科，研究药物如何作用于身体

senses.title: A shop where medicines are sold
senses.definition: a shop where medicines are prepared and sold and advice on their use is given
senses.definitionCN: 配药、售药并给出用药建议的店铺
senses.example: She picked up the cough syrup at the pharmacy downstairs.
senses.exampleCN: 她在楼下药房买了止咳糖浆。
senses.why: Greek pharmakon named the drug itself, and the place that keeps and sells drugs took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 pharmakon 本指药物本身，存放与出售药物的场所沿用了这个词，场所义由此而来。

senses.title: The science of preparing medicines
senses.definition: the branch of health science concerned with the preparation, use, and effects of medicines
senses.definitionCN: 研究药物的配制、使用与作用的一门健康科学
senses.example: He studied pharmacy for four years before working in a lab.
senses.exampleCN: 他在实验室工作之前学了四年药学。
senses.why: The skill of compounding drugs was a body of knowledge before it was a shop.
senses.whyCN: 把药配好本来就是一门知识，比「店铺」这层意思更早，所以同一个词也指药学。

senses.title: The work of dispensing medicines
senses.definition: the practical work of preparing and giving out medicines according to prescriptions
senses.definitionCN: 按处方配好并把药发出去的实际工作
senses.example: Safe pharmacy means checking the dose twice before it reaches the ward.
senses.exampleCN: 安全的配药意味着在药送到病房前把剂量核对两遍。
senses.why: A place name for drugs easily slides into the activity that fills that place.
senses.whyCN: 指「药物的场所」的名字，很容易滑向填满这个场所的活动，于是同一个词也指配药这项工作。

senses.title: The medicines unit of a hospital
senses.definition: the department inside a hospital that stores, prepares, and supplies medicines to the wards
senses.definitionCN: 医院内部储存、配制并向病房供应药品的部门
senses.example: The pharmacy sent the antibiotics up to the ward within an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 药剂科在一小时内把抗生素送到了病房。
senses.why: In a hospital the shop becomes an in-house department with the same name.
senses.whyCN: 在医院里，那间「店铺」变成院内部门，名字却照旧沿用。

intro.en: Pharmacy comes from Greek pharmakon, drug or remedy, through pharmakeia and medieval Latin pharmacia.
intro.cn: pharmacy 源自希腊语 pharmakon（药、疗法），经 pharmakeia 与中世纪拉丁语 pharmacia 进入英语。

items.en: Pharmakon means drug, remedy, and also poison, and the word carries all three at once.
items.cn: pharmakon 既指药、疗法，也指毒，一个词同时背着三重意思。

items.en: Pharmakeia names the use of drugs, including their preparation and their misuse.
items.cn: pharmakeia 指用药这件事，既包括配药，也包括滥用。

items.en: Medieval Latin pharmacia takes the Greek word for the practice of drugs.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 pharmacia 接过这个希腊词，指用药的行业与实践。

items.en: Farmacie reaches French as the word for a place of remedies.
items.cn: farmacie 进入法语，指存放与配制药物的场所。

items.en: English pharmacy appears in the fourteenth century for the preparation of medicines.
items.cn: 英语 pharmacy 在十四世纪出现，指药物的配制。

items.en: The shop sense and the science sense split apart, and hospital pharmacy becomes a department.
items.cn: 店铺义与学科义逐渐分开，医院里的药剂科也成为固定说法。

note.en: Pharmacy names both the place and the knowledge of drugs, and it stands beside pharmacist, drugstore, and dispensary.
note.cn: pharmacy 同时指场所与药物之学，旁边站着 pharmacist、drugstore 与 dispensary。

entries.definition: the person who prepares and dispenses medicines
entries.definitionCN: 配药、发药的人，即药剂师

entries.definition: relating to the making and selling of medicines
entries.definitionCN: 与药物制造和销售有关的，即制药的

entries.definition: the study of how drugs act on the body
entries.definitionCN: 研究药物如何作用于身体的学科，即药理学；与药学同源而侧重不同

entries.definition: an American shop that sells medicines and many other goods
entries.definitionCN: 美式说法，指兼卖药品与日用品的店铺

entries.definition: a room or small unit where medicines are given out
entries.definitionCN: 发药的小间或小部门，规模比药房小

entries.definition: the old name for a person or shop that prepared and sold medicines
entries.definitionCN: 旧时对配药售药者或店铺的称呼

normalIntro.en: Pharmacy comes from the Greek word for drug, and English has grown pharmacist, pharmaceutical, and pharmacology from the same stem.
normalIntro.cn: pharmacy 来自希腊语中表示「药」的词，英语用同一词干长出了 pharmacist、pharmaceutical 与 pharmacology。

normal.en: Pharmakon in Greek means drug, so pharmacy is the drug trade and the drug place at once.
normal.cn: 希腊语 pharmakon 意为药，所以 pharmacy 既是药业，也是卖药的地方。

normal.en: Add -ist and the word becomes pharmacist, the person behind the counter.
normal.cn: 加上 -ist，词就变成 pharmacist，即站在柜台后的人。

normal.en: Add -ology and it becomes pharmacology, the study of how drugs act.
normal.cn: 加上 -ology，就变成 pharmacology，即研究药物作用的学问。

normal.en: A hospital pharmacy is a department, while a community pharmacy is a shop.
normal.cn: 医院药房是一个科室，社区药房则是一家店铺。

normal.en: Pharmacy school trains people to check doses, not just to sell boxes.
normal.cn: 药学院训练人核对剂量，而不只是卖盒子。

abstract.en: Picture a green cross glowing over a door and shelves of small boxes behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象门头上绿色十字发亮，门后是一排排小药盒。

abstract.en: Imagine a bench with a mortar, a pestle, and scales for weighing powder.
abstract.cn: 想象一张工作台上摆着研钵、研杵和称药粉的小秤。

abstract.en: Think of a hand counting tablets into a paper bag against a printed order.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手照着打印的单子把药片数进纸袋。

examples.en: The pharmacy called to say the medicine was ready.
examples.cn: 药房打电话来说药已经配好了。

examples.en: Two pharmacies in the district share the night duty.
examples.cn: 这个区的两家药房轮流值夜班。

examples.en: She works in the hospital pharmacy on the ground floor.
examples.cn: 她在医院一层的药剂科工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「法玛西」——听着像「发了药才许走」，药房就是凭方发药的地方；这只是谐音联想，与希腊语 pharmakon 无关。

root: 希腊语 pharmakon（药；毒；疗法）→ pharmakeia（用药）→ 中世纪拉丁语 pharmacia → 古法语 farmacie → 英语 pharmacy，核心义「处理药的地方与学问」。

sensesIntro.en: Pharmacy begins as a place for drugs, grows into the science of preparing them, then the work done in that place, and finally the hospital unit that supplies the wards.
sensesIntro.cn: pharmacy 先指存放药物的场所，再指配制药物的学问，随后指在这个场所里做的配药工作，最后指医院里向病房供药的科室。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a green cross glowing above shelves of medicine.
core.cn: 核心意象：绿色十字灯箱照亮一排排药品。

branches.en: The shop is the sense most people meet first.
branches.cn: 店铺义是大多数人最先接触到的义项。

branches.en: The science of drugs is the older, academic sense.
branches.cn: 药学义是更早的学院式义项。

branches.en: The activity inside the shop gives the dispensing sense.
branches.cn: 店铺里进行的活动，长出了配药义。

branches.en: The hospital department keeps the place sense indoors.
branches.cn: 医院科室把场所义搬进了院内。

branches.en: The science and the daily dispensing work feed each other.
branches.cn: 药学与日常配药工作彼此支撑。

intro.en: Pharmacy rests on the Greek noun pharmakon, drug, and English built pharmacist, pharmaceutical, and pharmacology on the same stem.
intro.cn: pharmacy 立在希腊名词 pharmakon（药）之上，英语用同一词干造出 pharmacist、pharmaceutical 与 pharmacology。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin pharmacia and the Latin noun pharmacum both carry the Greek sense of a drug or remedy.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 pharmacia 与拉丁名词 pharmacum 都带着希腊语「药、疗法」的意思。

items.example: Pharmakon carries remedy and poison in one word.
items.exampleCN: pharmakon 一个词里同时装着药与毒。

items.example: Pharmakeia names the practice of using drugs.
items.exampleCN: pharmakeia 指用药的实践。

items.example: Pharmacia carries the Greek word into Latin medicine.
items.exampleCN: pharmacia 把这个希腊词带进拉丁医学。

items.example: Farmacie is the Old French form of the word.
items.exampleCN: farmacie 是这个词的古法语形式。

items.meaning: a drug shop or the drug science
items.example: Pharmacy holds both the place and the science.
items.exampleCN: pharmacy 同时容纳场所与学问两层意思。

items.example: The suffix -ist marks the person who dispenses.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 标出配药发药的那个人。

items.example: The suffix -ist turns a field into a person.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 把一个领域变成一个人。

items.example: Pharmaceutical describes the industry of making drugs.
items.exampleCN: pharmaceutical 描述制药这一行业。

items.example: Pharmacology adds -logy, the suffix for a field of study.
items.exampleCN: pharmacology 加上 -logy 这一学科词尾。

items.example: The suffix -logy marks a body of knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -logy 标出一门系统知识。

definition_zh: 处方；处方药；开处方；验光处方
definition_en: a written order from a doctor for a medicine, or the medicine supplied because of it
core_image: 一张写满药名与用量的纸，末尾是医生的签名
scene: 医生把药名、剂量和用法写在一张单子上，签好名递给了病人。The prescription was for a seven-day course of antibiotics.
sceneCN: 这里 prescription 是「处方笺」（第 1 个义项：医生写下的用药指令）；句意：这张处方开的是七天疗程的抗生素。

derivatives.zh: 开处方；规定；由拉丁语动词直接进入英语，指医生写下用药指令
规定的；规范的；-ive 形容词后缀，指以指令方式作出规定
开处方者；-er 表人，指有权开具处方的人

senses.title: A written order for medicine
senses.definition: a written instruction from a doctor or other qualified prescriber for a medicine, its dose, and its use
senses.definitionCN: 医生或有资格的处方者写下的用药指令，写明药名、剂量与用法
senses.example: She folded the prescription and put it in her bag.
senses.exampleCN: 她把处方折好放进了包里。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to write before, and the sheet is written before the medicine is taken.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词意为「事先写下」，药还没到手，纸上的指令已经先写好，处方笺就是这张先写的纸。

senses.title: The medicine supplied under such an order
senses.definition: the medicine itself, when it is supplied only because a doctor has ordered it
senses.definitionCN: 只有医生开单后才能拿到的那种药本身
senses.example: The pharmacist handed over the prescription in a sealed bag.
senses.exampleCN: 药剂师把处方药装进封好的袋子里递了过来。
senses.why: What the sheet orders is often called by the name of the sheet, so the medicine inherits the word.
senses.whyCN: 单子所开的药常常直接被单子的名字代称，药本身于是继承了 prescription 这个词。

senses.title: The act of ordering a medicine
senses.definition: the act of a doctor ordering a medicine or a course of treatment in writing
senses.definitionCN: 医生以书面形式开出药物或疗程的行为
senses.example: Careful prescription keeps the dose inside the safe range.
senses.exampleCN: 谨慎的开处方能把剂量控制在安全范围内。
senses.why: Once the written thing became routine, the act of writing it took the same noun.
senses.whyCN: 当「写这张纸」成为日常流程，写它的动作也用了同一个名词，义项从纸转向行为。

senses.title: A written measurement for lenses
senses.definition: a written measurement of the lenses a person needs for glasses or contact lenses
senses.definitionCN: 写明一个人配眼镜或隐形眼镜所需镜片度数的书面数据
senses.example: The optician checked her prescription before cutting the lenses.
senses.exampleCN: 验光师在切割镜片之前核对了她的配镜处方。
senses.why: An optician writes numbers for lenses in the same way a doctor writes for drugs, so the sheet sense stretches to glasses.
senses.whyCN: 验光师为镜片写下的数值，和医生为药物写下的指令是同一种纸，于是处方义延伸到了配镜。

senses.title: A plan offered as the cure for a problem
senses.definition: a plan or remedy put forward as the cure for a difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 为解决某个难题而提出的方案或疗法
senses.example: The report offered a prescription for the troubled service.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告为陷入困境的服务提出了一套解救方案。
senses.why: The idea of a written cure was easy to move from medicine to any problem that needs a remedy.
senses.whyCN: 「写下来的疗法」很容易从医学挪到任何需要解法的难题，比喻义由此生长。

intro.en: Prescription comes from Latin praescribere, to write in front, by way of praescriptio, a written order.
intro.cn: prescription 来自拉丁语 praescribere（写在前面），经由名词 praescriptio（书面指令）进入英语。

items.en: Scribere means to write, and the root survives in scribe, script, and inscription.
items.cn: scribere 意为书写，这个词根还留在 scribe、script 与 inscription 里。

items.en: Praescribere adds prae, before, and means to write at the head of a page, hence to order.
items.cn: praescribere 加上 prae（在前），指写在页面顶端，引申为下达指令。

items.en: Praescriptio is the written order itself, and it also serves as a legal term.
items.cn: praescriptio 指写下的指令本身，同时也是法律用语。

items.en: Prescription enters French as a written direction and a legal claim.
items.cn: prescription 进入法语，既指书面指示，也指法律上的主张。

items.en: English takes prescription for a written medical direction.
items.cn: 英语借入 prescription，指书面的医疗指示。

items.en: The medical sense dominates, then extends to spectacles and to public remedies.
items.cn: 医学义占据主导，随后延伸到配镜与公共对策。

note.en: Prescription is the written-before word, tied to prescribe and to other words built on the Latin verb for writing.
note.cn: prescription 是「事先写下」的那个词，与 prescribe 以及其它由拉丁语「写」动词构成的词相连。

entries.definition: to write an order for a medicine or treatment
entries.definitionCN: 写出用药或治疗的指令，即开处方

entries.definition: laying down what must be done
entries.definitionCN: 规定必须怎么做的，即规定性的

entries.definition: words written or carved on a surface
entries.definitionCN: 写在或刻在表面上的文字，与处方共享「写」这一词根

entries.definition: a treatment that cures or relieves a problem
entries.definitionCN: 能治好或缓解问题的办法，也可指药物

entries.definition: a drug used to treat an illness
entries.definitionCN: 用于治病的药物，比处方更强调药本身

entries.definition: the measured amount of a medicine taken at one time
entries.definitionCN: 一次服用的药量，是处方上必须写明的一项

normalIntro.en: Prescription is built from Latin prae, before, and scribere, to write, and the same stem gives prescribe and prescriptive.
normalIntro.cn: prescription 由拉丁语 prae（在前）与 scribere（写）构成，同一词干还给出 prescribe 与 prescriptive。

normal.en: Latin prae means before and scribere means write, so a prescription is written before the medicine is used.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 prae 意为在前，scribere 意为写，所以处方是在用药之前先写好的。

normal.en: A doctor who prescribes writes the prescription, and the prescriptive is what such an order insists on.
normal.cn: 开处方的医生写下 prescription，而 prescriptive 指这种指令所强加的要求。

normal.en: To fill a prescription means the pharmacist prepares the medicine named on it.
normal.cn: fill a prescription 指药剂师把单子上写的药配好。

normal.en: A repeat prescription lets a stable patient collect the same medicine again.
normal.cn: repeat prescription 让病情稳定的病人再次领取同样的药。

normal.en: A prescription drug is one you cannot buy off the shelf.
normal.cn: prescription drug 指不能在货架上随手买到的那种药。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of paper with a doctor signature at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸，最下面一行是医生的签名。

abstract.en: Imagine a sealed bag being handed across the counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一只封好的袋子从柜台那边递过来。

abstract.en: Think of a pen moving across a pad while the patient waits.
abstract.cn: 想象病人等着的时候，笔在便笺上快速划过。

examples.en: The doctor wrote a prescription for pain relief.
examples.cn: 医生开了一张止痛的处方。

examples.en: Prescriptions can now be sent straight to the pharmacy.
examples.cn: 现在处方可以直接发送到药房。

examples.en: He asked how much the prescription would cost.
examples.cn: 他问这张处方要花多少钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pre 加 script」——在拿药之前先写好的那张纸，就是处方；这只是拆词联想，不是严格的词源解释。

root: 拉丁语 prae-（在前）+ scribere（写）→ praescribere（写在前面、下令）→ praescriptio（书面指令）→ 英语 prescription，核心义「事先写下的用药指令」。

sensesIntro.en: Prescription starts as the sheet written before a medicine is used, passes to the medicine so ordered, to the act of ordering it, to a lens measurement, and finally to any plan offered as a cure.
sensesIntro.cn: prescription 先用来说用药之前写好的那张纸，再指凭它拿到的药、开药这个动作、配镜的度数数据，最后指任何被提出当作解法的方案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a signed sheet of paper naming a medicine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张写满药名、末尾签了字的纸。

branches.en: The signed sheet is the first and literal sense.
branches.cn: 签好字的单子是最先也最字面的义项。

branches.en: The medicine named on the sheet takes the name of the sheet.
branches.cn: 单子上写的药，直接用了单子的名字。

branches.en: The moment of writing gives the action sense.
branches.cn: 落笔的那一刻，给出了「开处方」这个动作义。

branches.en: A lens measurement is the same kind of written order for the eye.
branches.cn: 配镜度数是同一种写下来的指令，只是对象换成了眼睛。

branches.en: A written cure for a patient and a written cure for a problem share one image.
branches.cn: 给病人的书面疗法与给难题的书面疗法，共用同一个意象。

intro.en: Prescription is prae, before, plus scribere, to write, and English keeps the same stem in prescribe, prescriptive, and inscription.
intro.cn: prescription 是 prae（在前）加 scribere（写），英语在 prescribe、prescriptive 与 inscription 中保留着同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin praescribere and praescriptio supply both the act of ordering and the written order itself.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 praescribere 与 praescriptio 同时提供「下令」的动作与「书面指令」本身。

items.example: The prefix prae- puts the writing before the event.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 prae- 把「写」放在事情发生之前。

items.example: Scribere is the verb that gives the whole family.
items.exampleCN: scribere 是给出整族词的动词。

items.example: Scriptum is the written thing that the verb produces.
items.exampleCN: scriptum 是动词写出来的东西。

items.meaning: to write at the head, to order
items.example: Praescribere means to set down in writing beforehand.
items.exampleCN: praescribere 指事先用文字定下要求。

items.example: Praescriptio is the order that has been written.
items.exampleCN: praescriptio 就是已经写下来的指令。

items.example: Prescription keeps the noun sense of the Latin word.
items.exampleCN: prescription 保留了拉丁名词的义项。

items.meaning: to order a medicine or treatment
items.example: Prescribe is the verb for writing the order.
items.exampleCN: prescribe 是「写下这道指令」的动词。

items.example: The suffix -ive makes the order into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ive 把这道指令变成形容词。

items.example: Inscription shares the writing root with a different prefix.
items.exampleCN: inscription 换了前缀，却共享同一个「写」的词根。

items.example: Scribe keeps the bare Latin root in English.
items.exampleCN: scribe 在英语里保留了光秃秃的拉丁词根。

items.meaning: noun ending for an action or result
items.meaningCN: 表动作或结果的名词词尾
items.example: The suffix -tion forms prescription from the verb stem.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tion 由动词词干构成 prescription。
